venir de + infinitive = “just did something”

Examples:
Je viens de finir. → I just finished.
Il vient d’arriver. → He just arrived.
Nous venons d’acheter une voiture.
This is one of the most natural time expressions in French.

Think of it like:
“I come from doing X.”

French prefers structures instead of small time adverbs.
English:  I just ate.
French:  I come from eating.
